description: Mutes two signals together, from a button or a gate, with a choice of instant or click-free muting

params.text: Each press mutes and unmutes both outputs and lights the MUTED lamp; a cable in MUTE IN takes this button out of use
SOFT ramps the level whenever the mute changes, so audio does not click; HARD switches instantly

inputs.text: One of the two signals to be muted; all channels of a polyphonic cable are muted together
A gate above 2V here mutes both signals, and takes the mute button out of use for as long as a cable is patched

outputs.text: Carries the signal from IN 1, silenced while the mute is on
Carries the signal from IN 2, silenced while the mute is on

inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
